_comment: Maps local /assets/ paths to WordPress Media Library URLs.
Populated ONLY from the URL returned by a real media.create response.
Never hand-write an entry: a guessed CDN URL renders as a broken image on a
live page, and wp-export.mjs cannot tell a guess from a real one.
Any /assets/ path referenced by a page and missing here fails the export.

novra-share-card.webp.note: filesize in the media.create response matched the local file exactly, which is what proves the base64 transfer was byte-correct

_not_uploaded./assets/novra-convergence-architecture-m: Selecting it requires a max-width media query. Inline styles cannot express one and this plan hosts no stylesheet, so no page could reference it.
